cases.case: Research disclosure collapse/reopen after first load
cases.expected: Loaded child remains mounted while its owning tool remains active; component-local value survives.
cases.evidence: LazyFeatureBoundary unit test sets Sub-THz-style local value to 145, closes/reopens, and checks same value; production E2E repeats keyboard open and collapse/reopen.

cases.expected: No Research implementation request and no research action.
cases.evidence: Production E2E resource assertion sees Propagation/RF Diagnostics chunks absent on cold startup and Propagation absent after selecting ordinary Propagation until disclosure opens.

cases.case: Profile change before first Research open
cases.expected: First-mount defaults match the settings from Propagation tool entry, as under the former eager child mount.
cases.evidence: App captures propagation settings on tool-entry transition and passes snapshot on first lazy mount; SubTHZ/P1411 option initializers read only that supplied settings object. No dedicated profile-switch E2E fixture.
cases.status: code-audited; targeted switch scenario not independently exercised

cases.expected: Parent settings/result props track current workspace; transient component-local research options follow existing behavior.
cases.evidence: Current settings and results are passed as props, with transient controls owned by feature component. Existing suite tests profile/domain behavior; no added focused profile-after-open lazy test.
cases.status: code-audited; no targeted new switch fixture

cases.expected: Persisted override restores; remains independent of research module loading.
cases.evidence: Advanced control remains eager and App-owned; production E2E test `keeps a collapsed Advanced cell RF value through Version save and reload` passes at all configured projects.

cases.expected: Active Scenario/Version/result props come from the existing workspace state; module cache does not retain domain data for another Scenario.
cases.evidence: Lazy modules receive current App-owned props; current/stale/historical badges and Run source actions remain in existing components. Existing Run source-Version and blocked draft-switch E2E cases pass. No new case switches Scenario after loading every lazy feature.
cases.status: architecture audited; related workflow E2Es pass; full cross-feature matrix not separately exercised

cases.expected: Loaded JavaScript may stay cached, while app/domain props resolve against the active Project.
cases.evidence: No lazy entry stores Project state; Run/Report contents are passed from App and repository hooks. Existing project persistence/workflow tests pass; no focused project switch after every lazy boundary.
cases.status: architecture audited; targeted full matrix not separately exercised

cases.expected: Local feature fallback does not replace the map or domain lineage; the feature receives currentWorkspace/result context after mount.
cases.evidence: Result badges remain existing shared components; RunHistoryPanel and ReportFeature receive current workspace lineage. Cold historical Report E2E verifies source Run/Version action and preserved existing record.
cases.status: verified by architecture and related E2E

cases.expected: Loading/opening a feature does not enter canonical Run or Scenario input data.
cases.evidence: No request builder, run capture, scenario canonicalizer, or domain schema was modified; lazy state lives in component/loader. Full 275-unit suite passes. No separately serialized pre/post representative Run/fingerprint pair was captured.
cases.status: source boundary and regression-suite evidence; no standalone byte-for-byte snapshot comparison

cases.case: Report source and retained artifact continuity
cases.expected: Existing source binding, artifact bytes, content hash, availability and local download behavior remain unchanged; download does not rerun RF.
cases.evidence: Existing domain/report/repository helpers remain in use; download helper consumes exact stored bytes. Cold historical report E2E generates from the source Run after one initial compute request and displays retained report with source context. No pre/post artifact hash golden comparison captured.
cases.status: workflow verified; no independent prior-vs-new hash comparison

cases.expected: An invalid Advanced control remains available without waiting on a lazy feature; any lazy feature focus must happen after mount.
cases.evidence: OptimizationGoalsPanel and path-profile validation section remain eager; existing attention/focus behavior is not moved across the lazy boundary. Focused path-profile action E2E passes.

cases.expected: Feature error remains local with recovery; map and Run Sector control survive. Reload resets the browser module registry, then the feature can be requested again.
cases.evidence: Vitest verifies the feature-local alert and reload action. Production E2E aborts the first chunk request, reloads the app, requests the feature again successfully, and verifies the control is usable.

requestAndComputeInvariance.ordinaryPlanningE2E: One compute request is observed for the initial Run in cold Run History report-generation workflow; report generation adds none.
requestAndComputeInvariance.coverage: Existing request-equivalence/domain tests remain in the full passing frontend suite. The implementation changes import timing and presentation module placement only.

limits: This phase does not create a dedicated exhaustive Cartesian test across every lazy feature and Project/Scenario/profile transition.
A module remains in browser memory after first use; closing a tool is not module unloading.
Exact byte-for-byte report artifact hash and Run snapshot pre/post fixture comparisons were not separately captured for this phase.
